tools.name: create_entities
tools.description: Creates multiple entities in the knowledge graph. Entities with names that already exist are ignored.

entities.description: Entities, each with name, entityType and observations (string[]).

tools.name: create_relations
tools.description: Creates multiple relations between entities. Duplicates are skipped; fails if either entity is missing.

relations.description: Relations, each with from, to and relationType (active voice).

tools.name: add_observations
tools.description: Adds observations to existing entities. Fails if an entity does not exist.

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.description: Deletes entities and their associated relations. Missing names cause no error.

entityNames.description: Names of the entities to delete.

tools.name: delete_relations
tools.description: Removes specific relations from the knowledge graph.

relations.description: Relations, each with from, to and relationType.

tools.name: read_graph
tools.description: Returns the entire knowledge graph with all entities and relations.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Searches entity names, entity types and observation content, returning matching entities and their relations.

tools.name: open_nodes
tools.description: Retrieves entities by name, along with the relations between them. Non-existent names are skipped.
